observations.behavior: Adds per-title row mappers and a fan-out chain for movie and TV credits, seasons, and episodes; the warehouse connector now requests parent discover listings, then per-title credits, and flattens rows with movie_id or series_id. It also adds 404 ignore actions and a depth-based resume check.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes the warehouse ingestion path for TMDb metadata, allowing PostHog warehouse users to receive movie and TV credit, season, and episode rows with proper parent IDs and pagination. The connector now supports fan-out and resume behavior, and ignores 404s when a title leaves the catalog.

observations.behavior: Adds a resume configuration and row mappers, and the fan-out chain, while retaining the original bare-list endpoint. The connector now distinguishes paginated and single-page endpoints, and uses the parent field to resolve per-title requests.
